HeyGen vs VEXI: AI Avatars or Your Whole Social Media?
HeyGen and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
HeyGen makes AI avatar videos, including ones that star you [1]. Here is how it compares with one app that runs your social media with your own face and footage.

HeyGen makes videos presented by AI avatars, from a script, a prompt, images, audio or slides [1]. It can make a custom avatar of you, translate videos and add captions [1]. There is a no-cost tier with three watermarked videos a month; Creator is $29 a month ($24 a month paid annually), Pro starts at $49 a month, and Business is $149 a month plus $20 a seat [2]. Paid plans come with a monthly allocation of credits [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The two overlap on video. HeyGen makes the video, and its homepage says to download it, edit it and share it [1]. VEXI makes the posts around it too, with the designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. VEXI costs more than HeyGen: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
HeyGen makes videos presented by AI avatars, including a custom avatar with your own voice and likeness, and translates videos into 175+ languages and dialects [1][2].
VEXI edits the video for you: cuts, B-roll, music and captions. How deep the edit goes depends on your plan's mode, and anything you ask for wins.

Does HeyGen post to social media?
HeyGen's homepage says to download your video, edit it and share it [1]. VEXI posts to your connected accounts itself.
Can HeyGen edit my own videos?

HeyGen's AI Studio is a text-based editor with auto captions and B-roll, and HeyGen can translate footage you upload into 175+ languages and dialects [1]. VEXI edits the footage you shot: cuts, B-roll, music and captions.

HeyGen's no-cost tier gives three watermarked videos a month, up to a minute each [2]. Creator is $29 a month or $24 a month paid annually, Pro starts at $49 a month, and Business is $149 a month plus $20 a seat [2].
